notes.title: Update v1.0.270
notes.notes: [p]• Added improved compatibility for monitors that are narrower than 1.6 aspect ratio.[/p][p]• Fixed bug where moved explosive barrels would appear as normal barrels when reloading a save game.[/p]

notes.title: v1.0.268 update improves SteamDeck UI
notes.notes:
August 21, 2025

[list]
[*] Enhanced several UI elements to be more readable on SteamDeck.
[*] Some adjustments to visual FX speeds to match the selected game speed.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.264 Update
notes.notes:
August 19, 2025

[list]
[*] Fixed bug that resulted in some sounds still playing partially at full volume even when turned down.
[*] Fixed bug that would cause getting stuck on the loot screen.
[*] Added Q and E keyboard keys for left/right camera rotation, with a setting for reversing direction of it.
[*] Changed keyboard shortcut for showing energy emission to N, since E is now used for camera rotation.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.0.260
notes.notes:
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.01.257 adds tutorial info about energy, and death permanence.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added UI button for showing energy emission, and related tutorial information about it.
[*] Added text that describes the general source of each energy type on the energy emission dialog.
[*] Added tutorial information about death being permanent in the single-player campaign.
[*] Fixed bug that allowed scrolling the map view outside of the map bounds.
[*] Fixed issue that would show a path TOWARD an enemy instead of AWAY from it when clicking the enemy to attack with a bow when too close for bow range and not enough AP to move & attack.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes: [p]Shrouded Aspect was developed with gamepad controllers in mind, including the ability to play it on Steam Deck. However, official Steam Deck compatibility testing is only done by Valve at their own pace, so the best we can do right now is announce that it works.[/p][p]However, some text is too small to read when played on Steam Deck, so it helps to already be familiar with the game on a PC. Skill names and effects in particular are helpful to be familiar with in advance.[/p][p]I plan to enhance Shrouded Aspect's text sizes to be more Steam Deck friendly in the near future.[/p]
